title: make test-short fails on hosts whose git starts no auto-maintenance: TestTheHarnessStartsNoGitItDoesNotWaitFor
body: The control fixture in internal/reconcile/harness_maintenance_test.go:92 t.Fatal's when a plain commit+fetch starts no background maintenance, which is a property of the host's git version, not of the tree. It fails on this machine at the base commit 49b9d34 with my changes stashed, so every local gate run here goes red for a host condition — the exact 'a gate verdict is about the tree only if the host is bounded' case .tick/learnings.md records. The control needs to degrade to a skip (or detect the host's auto-maintenance support) rather than fail the suite.
